 Donovan Clingan records monster double-double Monday 
 by Ari Koslow | Trail Blazers Correspondent | Tue, Nov 3rd 2026, 2:08am EST 
 Donovan Clingan scored 17 points (8-16 FG, 1-3 3PT) to go along with 18 rebounds, three assists and four blocks in the Trail Blazers 118-110 win over the Nuggets. 
 Fantasy Impact: 
 Clingan bounced back in a big way from his performance on Saturday. He recorded his first double-double of the season in a big fashion.
